name: Mang Lang church
summary: See the church on the Kỳ Lộ that keeps the first Vietnamese book in chữ Quốc ngữ. It stands in An Thạch, Tuy An, and it was built in 1892. Phép giảng tám ngày was made in Rome in 1651. Hours and a ticket are Check on arrival. The north road to the stone plates passes the church.
getThere: On the Kỳ Lộ, in An Thạch, on the north road.
heroCaption: The two towers and the church front

body: Walk up to the church on the Kỳ Lộ, in An Thạch, Tuy An. Two towers face the yard. It was built in 1892 by Father Joseph de la Cassagne, called Cố Xuân, for Tu hội Thừa sai Paris. The lines are Gothic. It is one of the oldest churches in the country.

The grounds keep Phép giảng tám ngày, compiled by Alexandre de Rhodes and made in Rome in 1651. It is the first Vietnamese book in chữ Quốc ngữ. In 1641 he baptized more than 90 people here, including Anrê Phú Yên, and a memorial to Anrê stands in the grounds.

Hours and a ticket are Check on arrival. The church is a stop on the north road. The stone plates lie about 40 km north of town by Tuy An Bắc and this church. The kilometres from town to the church door are Check on arrival.
